question: The birth anniversary of Lord Jhulelal of the Sindhi community is also known as _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Cheti Chand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **birth anniversary of Lord Jhulelal of the Sindhi community is also known as Cheti Chand** or Jhulelal Jayanti. 
 
• Cheti Chand **is a festival celebrated by Sindhi Hindus to mark the birth of their patron saint, Lord Jhulelal.** 
 
• It is also celebrated as the Sindhi
